raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 14 was delivered twice, at 02:00 and 05:00 on 2026-01-19. That gives 666 rows, which is 333 txn_ids × 2, and the sampled copies are identical. silver_transactions has no dedup, so 318 POSTED txn_ids appear twice and every gold table double counts them. The fix is to dedupe by txn_id in silver.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.9,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
